verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs mention that integrations 'ensure your agent can retrieve data, take action, and handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels' (decagon-docs-33), implying some escalation handling, but there is no explicit description of passing the full conversation transcript, an auto-generated summary, and collected details to the human agent so the customer avoids repeating themselves. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of transcript/summary/detail hand-off mechanics, evidence of 'no repeat' UX, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
